title: srt: Parse Key Material message.
description:
Parse Key Material (KM) message in the Handshake extension and as a User-Defined message.
See the [Key Material Section](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-sharabayko-srt-01#section-3.2.2) of the Internet-Draft.
Sample capture for testing:
[HS_caller_AES-256-sender-1_listener_AES-128.zip](/uploads/e47c175340b5b62d5ac5dad086388888/HS_caller_AES-256-sender-1_listener_AES-128.zip)

notes.body: use bitmask on hf_ ? (same after)
The idea is only to use bitmask for hf defintion (but yes, it can be better to use proto_tree_add_bitmask when there is multiple bits
I'm not sure I understand how to do that.
@alagoutte Could you please provide an example of using the bitmask without grouping those fields? The only solution I see is to do a group with an empty name.

you are already using bitmask now

        {&hf_srt_km_pt, {
            "KM Payload Type", "srt.km.pt",
            FT_UINT8, BASE_DEC,
            NULL, SRT_KM_PT_MASK, NULL,
            HFILL} },

> SRT_KM_PT_MASK

you can use directly with proto_tree_add_item
